items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that the property 'S is Cohen-Macaulay' is local in the syntomic topology (statement lines 5142-5146). The proof displays the decomposition of Cohen-Macaulayness into locally Noetherian plus the (S_k) conditions for all k, and reduces the claim to the chapter's earlier result that the (S_k) condition is syntomic local (proof lines 5148-5152). The level is H2: short, but the decomposition is the substantive step and it is written out with its reference.
